column1: # Columns, separated by single tabs: id, group, name, kind, value, approximate size in MiB.
#   kind bbox: value is west,south,east,north in degrees. The region is cut from the
#              current Protomaps world build (OpenStreetMap data) when it is fetched.
#   kind url:  value is a ready-made .pmtiles file. The us-* groups are the regional
#              map collections of Project NOMAD (Apache License 2.0).
# Any other area can be fetched with: sudo offline maps get --bbox W,S,E,N --name NAME
# A group name stands for every region in it: sudo offline maps get continents
# The continents are generous rectangles that overlap at their edges; sizes were
# measured at full street detail (zoom 15) and grow a little with each build.
# Put your own regions in /etc/offline/maps.local.tsv using the same layout.
